notes.title: ✨ Interstellar Sentinel 2 – Surge & Balance Update
notes.notes: [h1][b]Interstellar Sentinel 2 – v0.5.0 Build Update Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="hE2nLz0P7CI;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]Gameplay & Balance[/h2][list][*][p]Increased player starting lives to [b]30[/b] (for Easy difficulty testing, reduces continue screen churn).[/p][/*][*][p]Shield power-up: increased attraction radius to make it easier to grab under duress.[/p][/*][*][p]Riot Shield Mechs:[/p][list][*][p]Nerfed overall health.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where shield could be left behind if the mech was killed under certain circumstances.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Large Robonoid Minigunner: added a little more time between bullet waves.[/p][/*][*][p]Materializer Tanks: increased HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Materializer Cannon: added more cannon shot strings and increased shot speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Highness & Royale Highness scores.[/p][/*][*][p]Astral Projection:[/p][list][*][p]Buffed melee damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted damage curves and tick rate for consistency.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rapid Shot: increased starting spread size and spread starting streams to 3, added wider spread shot streams on upgrades, adjusted damage curves for consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]Overcharge Swords:[/p][list][*][p]Added bullet impact sparks.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Enemies & Bosses[/h2][list][*][p]Large Robonoids:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed missing teleportation VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]First enemy surge: bring forward more, update teleport VFX/timing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]DTCD Boss:[/p][list][*][p]Intro: cut music, add screen shake during boss construction.[/p][/*][*][p]Robo Kensis building section: add hologram warnings for reverse/top/bottom buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Head phase 2: make a bigger moment with large outward particle explosion that then reverses into head reconstruction.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed laser tower section stuck bug.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Laser Towers:[/p][list][*][p]From top: added a warning indicator before appearing.[/p][/*][*][p]Laser tower field: base parts are now the criteria for triggering the enemy surge condition.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Space Ripper Enemy Surge Wave: (4 large Robonoids): add teleportation and/or back warning sign, offset entrance further back.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted health for both level 1 bosses[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Visual & Effects[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed laser grids / Robonoid vertical waves spawning too early.[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinel Tower: adjusted Z-sorting of H-building for enemy surge Materializer Tank.[/p][/*][*][p]Added boss damage chain combo maintainer.[/p][/*][*][p]Added chain combo maintainer for bosses in general.[/p][/*][*][p]DTCD Boss destruction: added music transition + explosion SFX tutorial confirmation text: changed from “reverse shot” to [b]Back Shot[/b] (also updated frontend button mapping).[/p][/*][*][p]Backward shot: fixed text confirmation.[/p][/*][*][p]Double-check [b]Loki rank condition[/b] (validation pending).[/p][/*][*][p]Secret item: Moved the spawn to the lower third of the screen, moved the sparkle and AOE ring above the clouds. notes.title: Steam Next Fest Free 0.3.0 Demo Update - Secret Caravan Challenge Added
notes.notes: [p]Thank you so much to all the Steam Next Fest players for checking out our game! Based on community playtesting, we've fixed a number of bugs, added a bit more polish, and added a secret bonus level for people chasing those high scores. [/p][p][/p][p]We're watching and listening, so don't hesitate to keep sharing your feedback and playtest videos. It's super fun to see the new strategies emerge.[/p]
